verdict_reason: Gladly documents a REST API with webhooks, a sandbox, and multiple customer-data resources, but credentials are not self-serve. A Gladly Administrator must grant API User permissions and create the API user/token within an existing Gladly organization.
main_blocker: Requires an existing Gladly org and Administrator-granted API User role.
open_questions: Rate limits: the search index found a Gladly rate-limit page, but its body was not included in SOURCES, so documented limits remain unverified.
API versioning and deprecation/sunset policy were not found in the supplied sources.
No self-serve signup or trial evidence was found; confirm whether a Gladly account/sandbox can be obtained without an existing customer relationship or sales contact.
SDK evidence covers the Chat SDK for Web, iOS, and Android; no official server-side REST API SDK languages were found.
Gladly MCP for Claude is enabled per organization, and the connector address is per-org (for example, https://mcp.us-1.gladly.com/acme/mcp); the official docs URL is used here as the MCP reference.
Confirm how the API token is transmitted in token-based Basic Authentication, such as username/password versus a bearer-style header.
Confirm whether any OAuth flow exists for the Gladly REST API; supplied auth evidence only names token-based Basic Authentication.
